scripts.dev: npm run db:migrate:local && concurrently -n client,worker -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace client" "wrangler dev --port 5001"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace server
scripts.cloudflare:dev: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run build --workspace client && wrangler dev
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run build --workspace client && wrangler deploy
